correctness.rationale: The surjectivity criterion S_6^3 to S_10 (rank 66) is equivalent to absence of geometric common zeros of three quartic partials by Euler identity and the complete-intersection Hilbert series; thus it proves geometric smoothness. The genus-six Cartier matrix entries are coefficients c_(2I-J)(F); a=6-rank H and p-rank=rank(H^6) over F2. Two independently coded exhaustive programs counted all 2097151 nonzero forms and agree on 688128 smooth and all 10 (f,a) counts. A separately written Buchberger and finite-field point-count verifier checked each explicit sample on 3 affine charts and counted N1..N6, establishing same Weil polynomial and different a. Complete source, outputs, and reproducibility instructions are included; risks are implementation errors and reliance on the standard Cartier formula, mitigated by independent algorithms.
